items.stem: Which TWO are true about the Reynolds number? (Select TWO.)

options.text: It compares inertial to viscous forces
options.rationale: Correct: Re is the ratio of inertial to viscous effects.

options.text: A high value indicates turbulent flow
options.rationale: Correct: above the critical range, flow is turbulent.

options.text: It has units of metres per second

options.rationale: Re applies to liquids and gases alike.

items.stem: The Bernoulli equation is valid only when the flow is approximately:

options.text: Steady, incompressible and frictionless along a streamline
options.rationale: Correct: Bernoulli assumes no significant friction or energy addition along a streamline.

options.text: Highly turbulent with large friction losses
Driven by a pump adding energy between the points
options.rationale: Energy addition requires an extended energy equation.
Bernoulli's basic form assumes incompressible flow.
